points.quote_text:
3.4. Through APIs (Application Programming Interfaces)

We offer APIs so that certain features, content, or services can interact with third-party tools or services.

  • If you use a third-party app or service that connects to your DeviantArt account via our APIs, those third parties will only get access to your Information if you have given your permission.
  • Some API-based sharing with our service providers (such as payment processors) occurs as part of their provision of services for us, as described above.

3.5. With Your Consent or by Your Request

If you ask us to connect your account or share information with a third party (for example, sharing artwork to a social network), we will only do so with your express permission.

For the avoidance of doubt, we may share your Information in manners other than as described above, pursuant to your explicit approval, or if we are legally obligated to do so.
